summary: BIMobject AB, a software company, engages in the development of digital services within building information modelling (BIM) worldwide. The company operates bimobject.com, a cloud-based marketplace for building and interior design products for architects, civil engineers and other professionals in the construction industry; Bim.com, a digital hub for structured product information; and Prodikt (prodikt.com), a platform used to share, access and use product information in projects. It also offers development services for digital product information covering BIM objects, environmental product declaration files, and life cycle assessments, as well as offers in data sharing. In addition, the company provides building materials, construction, doors, electrical, electronics, engineering and infrastructure, fabrics, fire products, flooring, furniture, HVAC, kitchen, landscaping, lighting, loading equipment, medical, plumbing, sanitary, signage, software, sports and recreation, walls, and windows products. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
